title: Plaintext Document Persistence in LocalStorage Violates Stated Zero-Storage Privacy Policy
evidence: src/App.tsx:148-154 executes saveStoredSession({ selectedSampleId, documentTitle, rawText, config, detectedFormat }) on every text change. Verified by audit/test_localstorage_persistence.test.ts.
reproSteps:
1. Open app at /?view=app.
2. Paste sensitive confidential text into editor or upload a document.
3. Open DevTools > Application > Local Storage > chunklens_session_v1.
4. Observe full document text stored in unencrypted plaintext.
impact: Proprietary or confidential documents remain permanently stored in browser local storage on the client machine, surviving browser restarts and accessible to anyone with access to the machine profile, directly contradicting the core privacy guarantee.
recommendedFix: Do not persist rawText in localStorage. Only persist chunking configuration (strategy, chunkSize, overlap, unit, encoding) and sample ID.

title: CWE-1236: CSV Formula Injection Vulnerability in Dataset Export
evidence: src/exporters/dataExporters.ts:68-79 only escapes double quotes and fails to neutralize leading formula characters (=, +, -, @). Verified by audit/csv_injection.test.ts.
reproSteps:
1. Upload a document containing text starting with =cmd|'/C calc'!A0 or @SUM(1,1).
2. Click Export > Download Dataset (CSV).
3. Open exported CSV in Microsoft Excel or LibreOffice Calc.
4. The spreadsheet application parses the field as an executable formula.
impact: Arbitrary command execution or data exfiltration via DDE/HYPERLINK when a user opens an exported dataset in spreadsheet software.
recommendedFix: Prefix any string cell value starting with '=', '+', '-', '@', '\t', or '\r' with a single apostrophe (') or tab before serializing to CSV.

title: Main-Thread Heatmap Matrix Computation (O(N^2)) & Unvirtualized DOM Freeze on Large Documents
evidence: src/engine/embeddings/vectorizer.ts:108-149 and src/components/SimilarityHeatmap.tsx:30 compute 2*N*(N-1) object entries in useMemo on main thread and render N^2 button elements without virtualization. At 2,000 chunks, execution takes 13.3s and 585.9 MB heap (verified in audit/heatmap_complexity.test.ts).
reproSteps:
1. Load a document resulting in 1,000+ chunks.
2. Click the 'Heatmap' tab.
3. The main UI thread freezes for 3 to 15+ seconds while computing TF-IDF dot products and mounting up to 1,000,000 DOM button nodes.
impact: Browser tab hangs (long task > 10s) and triggers 'Page Unresponsive' dialog or crashes with Out-of-Memory (OOM) at > 2,000 chunks.
recommendedFix:
1. Offload matrix calculation to the Web Worker.
2. Render heatmap via HTML5 Canvas or virtualized grid.
3. Cap matrix computation to first 250 chunks with user alert.

title: Invariant Violation: markdownChunker Synthesizes Content and Emits Negative Offsets [-1 .. -1]
evidence: src/engine/chunkers/markdownChunker.ts:160 injects artificial ``` fences around split code sub-blocks. In audit/invariants.test.ts, findChunkIndices returns startCharIndex: -1, endCharIndex: -1 for all split sub-blocks.
reproSteps:
1. Select Markdown Splitting strategy with chunkSize=40 chars.
2. Ingest code block with 5 lines.
3. Observe chunk text contains synthetic fences not in source, and inspector displays [-1 .. -1] offsets.
impact: Breaks core chunker invariant: chunk text is modified from original source, and character offset navigation fails completely.
recommendedFix: Do not mutate chunk text with artificial markdown fences; if fences are needed for LLM context, store them in a separate prefix/suffix field while preserving original raw text for offsets.

title: Invariant Violation: recursiveChunker Emits Negative Offsets [-1 .. -1] on Consecutive Delimiters
reproSteps:
1. Select Recursive Character Splitter.
2. Ingest text containing '



' between paragraphs.
3. Observe startCharIndex: -1 and endCharIndex: -1 in chunk metadata.
impact: Users inspecting chunks see broken offsets [-1 .. -1] and chunk text that does not match original document spans.
recommendedFix: Track slice offsets based on original text boundaries rather than relying on string.indexOf() after whitespace re-normalization.

title: Invariant Violation: sentenceChunker Normalizes Whitespace and Emits Negative Offsets [-1 .. -1]
evidence: src/engine/chunkers/sentenceChunker.ts:70 joins sentences with ' ' (single space). In audit/sentence_offsets.test.ts, documents with multiple spaces or tabs between sentences produce startCharIndex: -1 and endCharIndex: -1.
reproSteps:
1. Select Sentence Splitting strategy.
2. Ingest text with two sentences separated by two spaces or tabs: 'First sentence.  Second sentence.'.
3. Observe chunk text has collapsed spaces and startCharIndex is -1.
impact: Character offset tracking and highlighting fails whenever source document contains legal/formal double-spaced sentences or tab indentation.
recommendedFix: Preserve exact source substrings including inter-sentence whitespace when grouping sentences.

title: Invariant Violation: tabularChunker Computes Truncated Offsets on Duplicate Rows
evidence: src/engine/chunkers/tabularChunker.ts:142-144 uses findChunkIndices starting from startCharIndex for lastRow. When rows are identical, endCharIndex collapses to firstRow length. Verified in audit/tabular_offsets.test.ts.
reproSteps:
1. Select Tabular Splitting strategy.
2. Ingest CSV with duplicate rows (e.g. status,code\nactive,200\nactive,200...).
3. Inspect chunk offsets: charCount is 33, but endCharIndex - startCharIndex is only 10.
impact: Reported offsets cover only the first line of the chunk rather than the full tabular partition.
recommendedFix: Calculate character offsets by accumulating row character lengths directly from line split indices rather than searching substring duplicates.

title: Web Worker Uncaught Error Swallowed, Causing Indefinite UI Processing Freeze
evidence: src/engine/worker/chunking.worker.ts:34-36 catches exceptions during executeChunking and logs to console without posting a message back. useChunkingWorker.ts remains in isProcessing: true indefinitely.
reproSteps:
1. Trigger an exception in executeChunking (e.g. malformed configuration or memory spike).
2. Worker catches error and terminates message flow.
3. MetricsBar spinner displays 'animate-spin' permanently and UI never recovers.
impact: Silent UI lockup: the user sees an infinite loading spinner with no error message and cannot determine why chunking stopped.
recommendedFix: Catch worker errors and post a structured error response: self.postMessage({ id, error: error.message }). In useChunkingWorker, set isProcessing: false and propagate error to UI.

title: Documents Between 5 MB and 10 MB Trigger Uncaught QuotaExceededError in LocalStorage
evidence: src/utils/storage.ts:92 calls localStorage.setItem with documents up to 10 MB. In audit/test_localstorage_persistence.test.ts, a 6 MB document throws DOMException QuotaExceededError.
reproSteps:
1. Upload a 6 MB plain text document (well within the advertised 10 MB limit).
2. App processes document, then useEffect triggers saveStoredSession.
3. Browser throws QuotaExceededError in console and fails to store session.
impact: Storage write failure and console errors on valid uploads within the stated 10 MB product limit.
recommendedFix: Do not store document rawText in localStorage; store only metadata and configuration.

title: Marketing Discrepancy: '5 BPE Tokenizers' and 'Haystack' Code Exporter Are Not Present in Engine
evidence: LandingOverview.tsx, LandingFeatures.tsx, and Community tier claim support for 5 BPE Tokenizers and Haystack exporter. src/engine/types.ts:3 defines TokenizerEncoding = 'o200k_base' | 'cl100k_base', and src/exporters/codeExporters.ts has no Haystack implementation.
reproSteps:
1. Read Landing Page Community Tier and FAQ #3 and #5.
2. Inspect codebase types in src/engine/types.ts and codeExporters.ts.
3. Observe p50k, r50k, and Haystack are missing.
impact: User mistrust when attempting to use advertised BPE tokenizers or export Haystack pipelines.
recommendedFix: Align landing page copy to state 2 exact BPE tokenizers (o200k, cl100k) with multi-model estimates, and remove Haystack from FAQ until implemented.

title: Missing BOM & Binary Content Sniffing in useDocumentUpload
evidence: src/hooks/useDocumentUpload.ts:184 unconditionally decodes non-PDF buffers with new TextDecoder('utf-8'). Verified in audit/test_encodings.test.ts.
reproSteps:
1. Upload a UTF-16 LE encoded text file with BOM.
2. App misdecodes every character with interleaved null bytes (\u0000).
3. BPE tokenizer generates corrupted token partitions.
impact: Corrupted token counts and split points for UTF-16 files and renamed binary files.
recommendedFix: Check leading bytes for UTF-16 LE/BE BOM (0xFF 0xFE / 0xFE 0xFF) and inspect first 512 bytes for binary null bytes before passing to UTF-8 decoder.

title: WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size Violation on 'New Document' Button (20px Height)
evidence: src/components/Sidebar.tsx:140-147 has px-1.5 py-0.5 bounding box measuring 116x20 px. Measured via Chrome DevTools Protocol in audit/evidence/visual_audit.json.
reproSteps:
1. Inspect 'New document' button in left sidebar.
2. Measure computed bounding client rect height.
3. Measured height is 20px, failing WCAG 2.2 AA SC 2.5.8 (minimum 24x24 px).
impact: Difficult to accurately tap on touch devices and small pointer displays.
recommendedFix: Increase button vertical padding to min-h-[28px] or py-1.

title: Empty Document Incorrectly Displays '< $0.0001' Vector Cost Instead of '$0.00'
evidence: src/components/MetricsBar.tsx:31 formats cost as estimatedCostUsd < 0.0001 ? '< $0.0001' : ... When estimatedCostUsd is 0, it formats as '< $0.0001'.
reproSteps:
1. Reset document to empty state or upload an empty text file.
2. Observe Tile 4 in MetricsBar.
3. Vector Cost displays '< $0.0001' instead of '$0.00'.
impact: Minor visual glitch that misleads users into believing an empty corpus incurs an embedding cost.
